pipeline_order: verify catalog, source, acquisition, and schedule hashes
load only the case's frozen candidate source side or sides
use the exact frozen query without model authoring
retrieve candidates across the allowed source pool
select up to three contexts with stable tie ordering

reference_environment.environment_rule: record exact installed versions and hashes before the first run; any difference requires a pre-run lock amendment

retry_policy.exhausted_action: record collection failure; do not replace

source_pool_rule.left_only: only the pair's left source is indexed
source_pool_rule.mixed_left_first: both sources are indexed; left precedes right only for stable chunk-ID and exact-score tie resolution
source_pool_rule.mixed_right_first: both sources are indexed; right precedes left only for stable chunk-ID and exact-score tie resolution
source_pool_rule.right_only: only the pair's right source is indexed
